hints: There is a + and a ×. Which one does the order of operations do first?
After you find 4 × 5, add 8 to the result.

solution.methodName: PEMDAS: brackets, powers, × ÷ left to right, + − left to right

steps.action: Look at the operations: there is a + and a ×.
steps.why: Before calculating, check which operations are in the problem. The order of operations (PEMDAS) decides which one goes first.

steps.action: Multiplication comes before addition, so do 4 × 5 first: 4 × 5 = 20.
steps.why: In PEMDAS, M (multiply) comes before A (add). The + being on the left does not make it go first.
Only the addition is left, so it is done last.

trapNotes.17: This adds all three numbers: 8 + 4 + 5. The sign between 4 and 5 is ×, not +.
trapNotes.60: This adds first: 8 + 4 = 12, then 12 × 5 = 60. Multiplication must come before addition.
trapNotes.160: This multiplies all three numbers: 8 × 4 × 5. The sign between 8 and 4 is +, not ×.
